label: late-episode confident a1 choice at GO after a reward
explanation: Fires only at GO (never D1/D2), only when the previous trial was rewarded (in_rew=1 never... prev_reward==1 carries 100% of mass), almost only when the agent is about to choose a1 (99.8% of mass; model_act=1) with a strongly a1-favoring logit (choice>8 holds 88% of mass), and only late in the episode: zero activity before trial ~68, rising through 70-79 and concentrated at trials 80-99 (value is correspondingly low, <7.1). It is essentially a late-episode clock gated by rewarded-stay-on-a1; prev_action is almost always a1 (stay after common reward). Scored with the agent own policy logit (computed at GO, not future). Alternative using the upcoming action (action==1 & prev_action!=2 & prev_reward==1 & ep_trial>=80, dev F1 0.69, mass recall 0.98) has higher recall but lower precision. Remaining false positives are mostly in late a1 runs after recent unrewarded trials; activation tends to grow over consecutive rewarded a1 trials. Does not fire on a2 choices, after unrewarded trials, or early in the episode.
